name: qvac-afri-translate
description: Scan a document or paste text, then translate it between English and 19 Sub-Saharan African languages entirely on-device with the QVAC SDK. TranslatePsy-AfriSLM does the translation, QVAC OCR reads photographed pages, and assessModelFit picks the model size the machine can hold. No cloud, no API keys, no account.
author: QVAC by Tether
